title: Brady Bunch Book by Andy Edelstein & Frank Lovece
description:
Novels and Nibbles takes us on a nostalgic trip back to America’s favorite blended family. The Brady Bunch Book is filled with stories, photographs, and fun behind-the-scenes details. This delightful book celebrates the beloved television family that brought us bell-bottoms, sibling squabbles, and plenty of groovy adventures. Who can forget Marcia, Marcia, Marcia, and our special this week gives a playful nod to Peter Brady’s unforgettable “pork chops and applesauce” line.  

We are having just that for this week’s special Pork Chops & Applesauce with some yummy creamed potatoes thrown in there too. A buttermilk marinated pork chop from our local O’Quinn’s Butcher Shop,  breaded with seasoned flour and fried, served with creamy mashed potatoes and applesauce house-made, but first handpicked right from our apple tree in the front yard. Can’t get fresher than that!

Here’s a story about a lovely pork chop that met some fresh applesauce and it was much more than a hunch that they would make a tasty lunch or brunch!
